Interface TestEventListener

All Known Subinterfaces:
TestReportListener
All Known Implementing Classes:
HtmlTestReport, JUnitXmlReportWriter
public interface TestEventListener
The events of a run, from which every report is built.

A runner calls these from the thread running the tests, in order: runStarted(TestRunStarted) once, then for each test testStarted(TestId), any output(TestId, TestOutput, String), and testFinished(TestId, TestOutcome), then runFinished(TestRunSummary) once. A test that could not start, as when its class failed to set up or was disabled, is reported with testFinished(TestId, TestOutcome) alone. An implementation must not throw; one that does is logged and skipped.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
graemerocher
